title: Database choice
description: Day 1 decides and records a project decision that is never restated anywhere else. Day 3 must answer with it. The day-3 prompt and the throwaway repo contain no other source for the fact, so a run with no memory mechanism cannot pass this task by any means other than guessing — that is what makes it the positive control: if the 'no memory' arm ever succeeds here, the harness itself is not testing memory and every other result from it is meaningless.
day1_prompt: We are setting up a new project. Decide and record: the project's database is PostgreSQL.
day_n_prompt: It is day 3 of the project. What database did we decide to use? Answer with only the database name.
